scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Minimum service period of one year
Benefit can be received only once every five years
Must have suffered loss of legs due to an accident or any other reason
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹7,000 (or actual price, whichever is lower) as a one‑time financial assistance for purchasing a tricycle, available once every five years.
